Click on “iPhone, iPad, or Android Device” option and then click “Next”. As more devices are made available, they will be added to the list. Comments on this collection should be sent to custserv@usgs.gov .​ Multi-factor Authentication - Passkey EROS Registration System (ERS) now offers an option of accessing accounts using a Multi-factor Authentication (MFA) passkey as an added security feature. The option allows users to login into ERS and associated websites; EarthExplorer, GloVis, HDDS, etc. via cell phones, tablets, etc. that store the passkey. Users now have the option of using either the traditional registered Username/Password or the new Passkey option. Quick Start Guide First Time Setup First time setting a Passkey and for users that already have a registered Username/Password, enter your username/password information into the Sign In page and click on the “Sign in with USGS Password” button. Within the ERS user profile page, Click the dropdown with “Authentication Options”. Click “Add Authenticator”. At Register an Authenticator, enter a name for the authenticator, i.e. Mobile, Tablet, iPAD etc. Click “Continue”. Choose device to save your passkey. Click on “iPhone, iPad, or Android Device” option and then click “Next”. As more devices are made available, they will be added to the list. Make sure Bluetooth is enabled on the device to save passkey. Click “Next”. Scan QR code and follow instructions on your device and the website popups. You will receive an email confirming the saved passkey. Follow On ERS Passkey Login Users that already have a registered ERS account and a saved passkey can enter their registered “username” and click “Sign in with a passkey”. Note: a password will not need to be entered. The list of devices will display. Depending on the device you registered with, select “iPhone, iPad, or Android” choice or the device, if listed. Scan the QR code or check your device for a connection notification. Follow the steps on the device. Once completed you will be logged in. (Detailed instructions at ERS Multi-Factor Passkey Help or access Help in the menu bar.) Comments on this collection should be sent to custserv@usgs.gov .​ Multi-factor Authentication - Passkey EROS Registration System (ERS) now offers an option of accessing accounts using a Multi-factor Authentication (MFA) passkey as an added security feature. The option allows users to login into ERS and associated websites; EarthExplorer, GloVis, HDDS, etc. via cell phones, tablets, etc. that store the passkey. Users now have the option of using either the traditional registered Username/Password or the new Passkey option. Quick Start Guide First Time Setup First time setting a Passkey and for users that already have a registered Username/Password, enter your username/password information into the Sign In page and click on the “Sign in with USGS Password” button. Within the ERS user profile page, Click the dropdown with “Authentication Options”. Click “Add Authenticator”. At Register an Authenticator, enter a name for the authenticator, i.e. Mobile, Tablet, iPAD etc. Click “Continue”. Choose device to save your passkey. Click on “iPhone, iPad, or Android Device” option and then click “Next”. As more devices are made available, they will be added to the list. Make sure Bluetooth is enabled on the device to save passkey. Click “Next”. Scan QR code and follow instructions on your device and the website popups. You will receive an email confirming the saved passkey. Follow On ERS Passkey Login Users that already have a registered ERS account and a saved passkey can enter their registered “username” and click “Sign in with a passkey”. Note: a password will not need to be entered. The list of devices will display. Depending on the device you registered with, select “iPhone, iPad, or Android” choice or the device, if listed. Scan the QR code or check your device for a connection notification. Follow the steps on the device. Once completed you will be logged in. Quick Start Guide First Time Setup First time setting a Passkey and for users that already have a registered Username/Password, enter your username/password information into the Sign In page and click on the “Sign in with USGS Password” button. At Register an Authenticator, enter a name for the authenticator, i.e. Mobile, Tablet, iPAD etc. Click “Continue”. Choose device to save your passkey. Click on “iPhone, iPad, or Android Device” option and then click “Next”. As more devices are made available, they will be added to the list. Make sure Bluetooth is enabled on the device to save passkey. Click “Next”. Scan QR code and follow instructions on your device and the website popups. You will receive an email confirming the saved passkey. Comments on this collection should be sent to custserv@usgs.gov .​ Multi-factor Authentication - Passkey EROS Registration System (ERS) now offers an option of accessing accounts using a Multi-factor Authentication (MFA) passkey as an added security feature. The option allows users to login into ERS and associated websites; EarthExplorer, GloVis, HDDS, etc. via cell phones, tablets, etc. that store the passkey. Users now have the option of using either the traditional registered Username/Password or the new Passkey option. Quick Start Guide First Time Setup First time setting a Passkey and for users that already have a registered Username/Password, enter your username/password information into the Sign In page and click on the “Sign in with USGS Password” button. Within the ERS user profile page, Click the dropdown with “Authentication Options”. Click “Add Authenticator”. At Register an Authenticator, enter a name for the authenticator, i.e. Mobile, Tablet, iPAD etc. Click “Continue”. Choose device to save your passkey. Click on “iPhone, iPad, or Android Device” option and then click “Next”. As more devices are made available, they will be added to the list. Make sure Bluetooth is enabled on the device to save passkey. Click “Next”. Scan QR code and follow instructions on your device and the website popups. You will receive an email confirming the saved passkey. Follow On ERS Passkey Login Users that already have a registered ERS account and a saved passkey can enter their registered “username” and click “Sign in with a passkey”. Note: a password will not need to be entered. The list of devices will display. Depending on the device you registered with, select “iPhone, iPad, or Android” choice or the device, if listed. Scan the QR code or check your device for a connection notification. Follow the steps on the device. Once completed you will be logged in. (Detailed instructions at ERS Multi-Factor Passkey Help or access Help in the menu bar.) Comments on this collection should be sent to custserv@usgs.gov .​ Multi-factor Authentication - Passkey EROS Registration System (ERS) now offers an option of accessing accounts using a Multi-factor Authentication (MFA) passkey as an added security feature. The option allows users to login into ERS and associated websites; EarthExplorer, GloVis, HDDS, etc. via cell phones, tablets, etc. that store the passkey. Users now have the option of using either the traditional registered Username/Password or the new Passkey option. Quick Start Guide First Time Setup First time setting a Passkey and for users that already have a registered Username/Password, enter your username/password information into the Sign In page and click on the “Sign in with USGS Password” button. Within the ERS user profile page, Click the dropdown with “Authentication Options”. Click “Add Authenticator”. At Register an Authenticator, enter a name for the authenticator, i.e. Mobile, Tablet, iPAD etc. Click “Continue”. Choose device to save your passkey. Click on “iPhone, iPad, or Android Device” option and then click “Next”. As more devices are made available, they will be added to the list. Make sure Bluetooth is enabled on the device to save passkey. Click “Next”. Scan QR code and follow instructions on your device and the website popups. You will receive an email confirming the saved passkey. Follow On ERS Passkey Login Users that already have a registered ERS account and a saved passkey can enter their registered “username” and click “Sign in with a passkey”. Note: a password will not need to be entered. The list of devices will display. Depending on the device you registered with, select “iPhone, iPad, or Android” choice or the device, if listed. Scan the QR code or check your device for a connection notification. Follow the steps on the device. Once completed you will be logged in. (Detailed instructions at ERS Multi-Factor Passkey Help or access Help in the menu bar.)
